description: Deterministic abstract/metadata-based clinical evidence report policy.

rules.direct_intervention_scope: Requested-drug evaluation or direct comparison only.
rules.condition_coherence: Different primary disease remains contextual unless substantive target-condition results are reported.
rules.safety_intent: Drug-specific substantive safety results may be direct; efficacy-only evidence is contextual.
rules.preclinical_gate: Preclinical-only evidence is audit-only for implicit human clinical queries.
rules.safety_signals: Case reports/series route to Early safety signals and pharmacovigilance routes to Pharmacovigilance signals.
rules.historical: Historical placement requires explicit configured metadata or conservative publication context; citation count is not used.
rules.causality: Observed events, associations, disproportionality, and causality remain distinct.
rules.uncertainty: Missing or ambiguous fields remain not_reported, unclear, or not_extractable.
